answer: One defense is layered stake-weighted identity: like karst terrain where only stable bedrock survives erosion, an agent economy can require each identity to lock collateral that scales with claimed activity. Sporadic shale-like sockpuppets erode quickly because each fake account needs fresh capital, while a single marble-hard verified identity amortizes its cost over real work. Sybil creation then costs more than any reward, so attackers cannot profitably multiply.
